description:
Feel the sea breeze and the endless horizon!
This is the beginning of a grand journey. For the first time, you step aboard a luxurious liner to spend an unforgettable honeymoon!
In Cruise Adventure: Hidden Journey, warm encounters and cozy evenings await, as your route takes you through the colorful islands of the Pacific Ocean.
This isn't just a sightseeing tour, it's a celebration of life, where every day brings new emotions.

Why you'll love this game:
-Engaging storylines! From the care and love of newlyweds to the developing relationship between a distinguished captain and a female manager.
-A carefree atmosphere: join parties, play in the casino, and enjoy diving in the Pacific waters.
-Collect memories: Gather unique souvenirs from ports of call — memorable keepsakes from every destination you visit.
-Rich bonus search content: Beyond the main item list on each location, a whole set of additional items awaits you!

This isn't just a game.
It's a lifestyle: with new friends, carefree moments, and the atmosphere of a daily celebration.
Ocean, luxury, and love are just a click away.

Collector's Edition includes:
-18 additional hidden object scenes — even more cozy locations and details to explore.
-12 new mini-games + 18 bonus games — for those who love a challenge along the way.
-A souvenir collection — gather unique mementos from every port, like true traveler's trophies.
-Beautiful desktop wallpapers and a music player with a wonderful soundtrack.
